description: This file contains shell script code used for testing the color functionalities of 'git blame' command, including various test cases for coloring lines based on criteria such as contiguity and age.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, specifying the test description and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color information from raw blame output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a file matches expectation.
